pr_metadata.title: feat(bench): purpose-built Native HA benchmark client (persistent throughput/latency, percentiles)
pr_metadata.summary: Adds clients/bench_client.py, a controlled persistent-commit benchmark (warmup + measure, p50/p95/p99/max commit latency, steady-state throughput, JSONL results record) reusing app_requester's stats/textfile/reconnect helpers, plus a bench-client Ansible role that deploys it to app-client on demand parameterized by target QM.
pr_metadata.notes: Task 7 of epic #227. Scope: bench client + deploy path only (netem knob is Task 6, sweep runner + experiment is Task 8). Pure logic (nearest-rank percentiles, depth-trend flag, JSONL record shape) is unit-tested in tests/test_bench_client.py; clients/ is outside the --cov=src gate by design so the pymqi PUT/commit loop is not unit-tested. bench_client.py does 'import app_requester' (the dr_flow<-dr_mqi in-dir reuse pattern); the bench-client role is wired into the app play in site-distributed-shared.yml AFTER app-requester so app_requester.py is co-located for that runtime import. Validation: vrg-container-run -- vrg-validate green (1216 tests, 100% src coverage, lint/audit clean). Note: vrg-commit produced the commit without a Co-Authored-By trailer and the wrapper offers no trailer/amend flag (raw git + vrg-git reset are denied), so the trailer could not be added.
